ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, icons, dark surfaces — the dominant neutral; never use pure #000 for text

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, modal panels, text on dark buttons — the brightest surface in the stack

warm-canvas.$description: Warm Canvas — Page background, subtle section divider — the off-white that gives the system its warm analog feel

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Hairline borders, input backgrounds, divider lines — the quietest structural neutral

stone-gray.$description: Stone Gray — Button borders, disabled outlines

pewter.$description: Pewter — Subtle shadow tint, placeholder text in low-emphasis contexts

iron.$description: Iron — Secondary text, nav links, muted body copy — the workhorse mid-gray

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Product accent — Pathfinder agent, data-viz category, teal-tinted section backgrounds pair it

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Product accent — VoiceHunter agent, primary feature category, violet wash sections

deep-amber.$description: Deep Amber — Product accent — LoopCloser agent, gold-tinted section backgrounds and warm callouts

deep-plum.$description: Deep Plum — Product accent — additional agent or feature category, paired with pinkish washes

deep-navy.$description: Deep Navy — Product accent — analytics or infrastructure category

deep-maroon.$description: Deep Maroon — Product accent — heading accent on warm-toned pages

deep-umber.$description: Deep Umber — Product accent — rust-toned category, icon and illustration accent

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Product accent — dark variant of the violet for headings and iconography on light surfaces

burnt-sienna.$description: Burnt Sienna — Dark amber — heading text when a warm-tone treatment is needed; Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

violet-wash.$description: Violet Wash — Soft tinted background — feature section panels, agent card backgrounds

teal-mist.$description: Teal Mist — Soft tinted background — teal-categorized section panels

amber-cream.$description: Amber Cream — Soft tinted background — gold-categorized section panels

apricot-wash.$description: Apricot Wash — Soft tinted background — warm secondary section panels

violet-veil.$description: Violet Veil — Badge and small-card background — violet category

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Badge and small-card background — teal category

honey-veil.$description: Honey Veil — Gray supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

inter.$description: All UI, body, nav, button, and badge text — body at 14–16px/400, nav and labels at 12–13px/500, button text at 14–16px/500, inline emphasized text at 600

eudoxus-sans.$description: All display and heading copy — hero at 58px/800, section headings at 48px/800, sub-headings at 32px/700; the tight -0.035em tracking at display sizes and heavy weight give headlines physical, sculptural presence that contrasts Inter's workhorse body

karla.$description: Karla — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
